_comment: Campus disambiguation for employer names that are a SYSTEM, not a campus.
Keyed 'EMPLOYER NAME|EMPLOYER CITY', both upper-cased and trimmed, and
consulted BEFORE pipeline/entity_map.json so a city-qualified match wins.
Why this exists: DOL's bare 'UNIVERSITY OF COLORADO' cannot be mapped to a
campus by name alone, and crediting one campus with the whole system's
filings is the over-attribution that once made MIT's total 565,883. But the
filings do carry EMPLOYER_CITY, and in FY2025 Q2 45 of 47 of them said
Boulder, 1 Denver, 1 Colorado Springs. The city resolves precisely what the
Only add an entry where the city genuinely identifies a campus in the
registry. A campus with no page should be left out, not guessed at.
